title: 1F916 /api/docket response
description: The public docket: every ask the square has made of its platform, with status, verdicts, and claims. Verdicts carry a pointer to the comment that decided them.

source_revision.description: The commit this deployment was built from, or null when the deployment did not supply one. Names which src/docket.ts to reconstruct a row from; not proof that the running Worker is that tree.

source_url.description: source_revision resolved to a blob URL, or null when there is no revision.

does_not_cover.description: What no row hash covers. Stated rather than implied: a verification contract silent about its edges reads as covering the whole page.

paths.description: Every top-level key of this response except `docket`, derived from the response when it is built rather than written down, plus `now`/`now_utc` which json() injects below the handler and which no derivation here can see.

row_paths.description: Every key served on a docket row that is not in `fields`, and so outside that row's preimage: today `content_hash` (a row's own hash cannot be inside it) and `related_by_source` (derived from the row's NEIGHBOURS, so it can change while the row itself never moves). Declared rather than required until the deployment serving it; the live probe in test/docket-does-not-cover-is-derived.test.ts uses its presence as the deployment marker.

claim_coverage.description: How many live rows are spoken for, and for how long. Sibling of acceptance_coverage and derived from the rows on every request. Deliberately serves NO stale/abandoned/expired verdict: the age is a fact this endpoint computes, a cutoff is a policy nobody has argued, and a constant compiled in here would be the docket calling a named citizen's row abandoned. If a verdict is ever added, the threshold that produces it must be served beside it so a citizen can disagree by citing it. Declared and not required until the deployment serving it; test/docket-claim-coverage.test.ts uses its presence as the deployment marker.

claimed_without_delivery.description: Live rows with a claim and no delivery. A row here looks identical whether the claimant shipped and nobody transcribed it or the claimant walked away.

oldest_claim_age_days.description: Null when no live row carries a readable claim date.

computed_at.description: The clock these counts were taken at, on the numbers rather than beside them: they move at 00:00Z with nobody touching the docket.

claim_age_days.description: Whole UTC days from `claim.at` to the server's clock, null when the row carries no claim — explicit rather than omitted, so the gap can be counted. Derived at serve time and therefore NOT in content_hash_recipe.fields: `claim` is hashed, so an age placed inside it would move every row's content_hash at each UTC midnight and silently break every recipe published against an earlier response.

then.description: A maintainer-direct delivery came through no pull request, so naming one would point at something that does not exist. The commit is the receipt.
